content.comment_body: Hi! I have a question regarding which software I need to install for the [product_name] text display panel. The starter pack includes a [product_name] base module, a power supply, and the text display panel. It also contains [product_name] engineering software [version_no], images for legacy panels, and a text display feature. Text and communication functionalities are working well. [user_name]

The text display panel does not require its own software. You can configure it using [product_name] engineering environment. Within that software, you create message texts, which are shown on the text display panel.

Thank you! Using this approach, you’re able to show texts multiple times. Previously, a communication issue was resolved by reinstalling the operating system from Windows 7 Ultimate to Windows 8.1 Professional. Since then, communication works well, and the web editor functions correctly. I’ve also discovered helpful features for analog signal processing. The engineering software supports M26, M30, and M31. I enjoy working with [product_name] regularly.
I’m asking about what is needed in the starter pack for '[product_name] engineering software [version_no]' and 'images for legacy panels'?

Hello, please share all details about your starter pack. If it includes [product_name] engineering software, it enables you to create HMI projects that connect with your [product_name] device. Is this what you intend to do? Which HMI model do you own? In my experience, the built-in display on the [product_name] base module is usually sufficient. The text display panel can be configured similarly and assists with alarms, messages, and timer/counter/target settings. Personally, I found it necessary to use an HMI for some tasks. If you describe your goals, others can advise more effectively.

Included items: 1 [product_name] base module ([article_no]), 1 text display panel, [product_name] engineering software [version_no], legacy panel images, [product_name] engineering software [version_no], USB stick, screwdriver. Does this configuration need any software apart from [product_name] engineering software?

- Legacy panel images, - [product_name] engineering software [version_no] - USB stick (license keys for [product_name] engineering software are on the stick) are only necessary if you plan to use an HMI panel. However, [company_name] supplies software with a basic license for free in the starter pack, should you wish to purchase an HMI panel later. Only [product_name] engineering software [version_no] is needed for configuring the [product_name] base module and text display panel—no license key required.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clear information on what software is necessary for setting up and working with the [product_name] text display panel, especially considering the contents of the starter pack. Communication issues are resolved with the correct setup, and the overlapping inclusion of multiple software applications in the starter pack causes confusion about their actual necessity. Most users find configuration straightforward with [product_name] engineering software, but were initially uncertain about the roles of other bundled items such as legacy panel images and HMI-related software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear instructions on required software for the [product_name] text display panel, along with explanations about why certain software is included in the starter pack and which items are truly necessary for their setup.
